newsitem.title: USA: Prime Service Inc sets IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Prime Service Inc sets IPO terms.

text.p: Prime Service Inc set terms of its proposed initial public offering at 7.25 million shares to be offered in an estimated range of $22 to $25, according to a regulatory filing.
The offering, lead managed by CS First Boston, is tentatively scheduled to make its market debut on October 31, with shares trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol PRS.N.

Prime Service, headquartered in Houston, Texas, is the second largest U.S. rental equipment company, based on 1995 revenues. It operates 101 rental equipment yards in 13 states where it rents forklifts, portable air compressors and other equipment, according to the filing.
Prime Service had 1995 revenues of $242.8 million.
